name: PDF Solution Statika
reviewNote: Consumable: one download of the current problem as a PDF with the full worked solution (the problem statement alone is free). Tap the page icon next to the star above the beam drawing on the main screen, then "Zadání s řešením · price" (Russian UI: "Условие с решением"). After the payment the PDF is generated and the system share sheet opens. Every download with the solution is a new purchase.
